verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that a report number can be traced back through its formulas to the source lines that produced it, such as drill-through or calculation lineage. The nearest items are block-level edit histories (an audit of who edited what, not formula lineage), a function library, and variance analysis, which are adjacent features and earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a planning platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a finance lead, any number in a report traces back through the formulas and source lines that produced it
